philippines.title: Victims’ counsels back ICC prosecution’s bid to protect 55 witnesses
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines — The legal representatives of drug war victims expressed their support for the prosecution’s request before the International Criminal Court (ICC) to allow their witnesses to use pseudonyms as well as to testify in closed sessions. In a 10-page submission published on the ICC website on Thursday, the Common Legal Representatives of the Victims (CLRV) submitted their response to prosecution’s Nov. 5 request for protective and special measures for 55 of its witnesses. philippines.title: Lone bettor wins P26.91-M Lotto 6/42 jackpot on Nov. 19
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines — A lone ticket holder won the P26.91 million Lotto 6/42 jackpot on Thursday, Nov. 19, 2026, draw, while no bettor won the P120.56 million Super Lotto 6/49 jackpot, according to the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO). The winning combination for Lotto 6/42 was 15-40-08-34-23-10, which secured the P26.91 million jackpot for one ticket holder. Meanwhile, the Super Lotto 6/49 draw produced the combination 23-24-10-02-09-37. No ticket matched all six numbers, leaving the P120.56 million jackpot without a winner. Minor games The PCSO also released the results of the 6D Lotto, 3D Lotto and 2D Lotto draws on Thursday. […]...
